name: Mazdutide
description: Injected peptide that acts on two hormone receptors, GLP-1 and glucagon; approved in China

note.lead: Approved in China, not the US.
note.text: A drug review reports approval in China (Xinermei) in 2025. No US Phase 3 weight trial was found.

bullets: **Acts on** two hormone receptors: GLP-1 and glucagon
**Given once a week** under the skin in trials
**First made by Eli Lilly** (LY3305677); developed in China as IBI362
**No FDA label,** so there is no approved mechanism statement

practical.routes: Injection under the skin, once weekly (trials)
practical.soldAs: Not approved in the US; FDA warned “research use” sellers
practical.monitored: Body weight, stomach and bowel effects

regulatory.text: Not approved; warned sellers of “research” mazdutide

references: Ji et al., GLORY-1, N Engl J Med, Jun 2025
Shirley, Mazdutide: First Approval, Drugs, Dec 2025
FDA, Concerns with unapproved GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss, Oct 2026
